$description: Where and how a PageSpec may reference tokens. Every name resolves against tokens/llm/token-catalog.json (generated from the real token files); verify_all.py (token-policy-resolves) fails if a slot, allowed name or rule id here does not resolve. schema/semantic_validate.py enforces the rules below under the same rule ids, which are also declared in compatibility/graph.json.
referenceForm: token NAME only (e.g. 'surface.panel', 'spacer-band', 'inter'); never a value

rawValuePatterns.function: rgb( rgba( hsl( hsla( oklch( color(
rawValuePatterns.length: <number>px | <number>rem | <number>em | bare number in a spacing slot

rules.TOKEN_UNKNOWN: a token slot names something that is not in the catalog for any theme
rules.TOKEN_RAW_VALUE: a raw hex / rgb() / hsl() colour in a token slot or in any non-link content string
rules.TOKEN_ARBITRARY_SPACING: a spacing slot holds a px/rem/number or a spacing name outside slots.node.tokens.spacingY.allowed
rules.TOKEN_UNSUPPORTED_FONT: a font slot names a family outside typography.fontFamily, or one not used by the template's chrome family
rules.TOKEN_THEME_MISMATCH: a semantic token that exists only in the OTHER theme (e.g. text.link-category on a mars page, surface.panel on legacy-black), or a slot/prefix mismatch (a text.* token in the surface slot)

enforced.node.tokens: optional, closed object (schema) + the five rules above (semantic validator)

overrides: node.tokens is OPTIONAL and added in pageSpecVersion 1.2.0 so token references are machine-checkable. Section contracts still own styling; the clone example does not use it and the clone itself has no per-instance token override, so a renderer that honours node.tokens is not evidenced in the source (agent decision, recorded honestly).

convention.color: reference semantic names (tokens/10-semantic), never foundation hex
convention.radius: mars is square (radius.mars.none); rounded radii exist only in the legacy-black family and the calculator
